mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which potentiates amlodipine's vasodilatory effects and increases hypotension risk; amlodipine may worsen renal perfusion during amphotericin B therapy.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, assess renal function and electrolytes regularly, consider dose adjustment of amlodipine, and implement nephroprotective strategies (saline hydration, lipid formulations of amphotericin B preferred).
